Upper Redfish/HTTPS (25,16) is equally adjacent to the row-15 NVOS and row-17 Power runs. Prometheus :9400 (26,30) lies between two arrowheads, with one blank at either end. Spec ownership does not repair perceptual ambiguity; routes are geometrically traceable but the required relation meanings are not uniquely readable.

[BLOCKER: unsupported interface] hosts FM? is visibly qualified by a question mark and dashed straight segments. Its source box is Driver+CUDA, not a compute-host box: common host residency does not establish that the driver stack hosts Fabric Manager. The allowed source excerpts supply no such hosting/interface fact. Keep this audit blocked rather than promote it to a verified dependency. Solid curved bends and a solid arrowhead do not erase the clearly dashed uncertainty style and are not a separate rubric defect.

Thirteen named concepts are present, yet the where-software-resides task is not fully answered. This is a missing required fact, not a requirement to add every optional physical detail.

This placement study needs it grouped with compute-host software, or an explicit source-backed explanation of a different grouping concept. None is printed. The finding concerns source-unsupported grouping within v2, not cross-view exact-hue stability.

The complete v2 capture contains six in-band/Fabric nodes and none of those RMS/NVOS/NMX nodes or edges. Required relations do exist in v1, so this is not a claim of globally missing controller edges; it is a false cross-view evidence inventory.
